note: WHAT HAS BEEN READ, declared so the gate can check it. A reading pass in the PAPERS epic names the range it read here; tools/compile_gazetteer.py --check resolves each range against corpus.json and refuses if any issue inside it has no file under extracted/. Coverage is the one property no other assertion can see: every rule in the gate is about a claim that EXISTS, and a skipped issue leaves nothing behind to fail. Add a range only when its issues have all been read — this file is a statement about work done, not a plan.
